// EXTRACT of concept-db src/routes/impulses.ts at 60172300's parent: the 78b70967 extract (below, unchanged) plus the
// write-scope refusal block verbatim (:152-217, WRITE_SCOPE through writeScopeRefusal), which 60172300's check quotes
// ("Write scope required", WRITE_SCOPE_REQUIRED). The block is never called on this path, as in the original, where the
// 400 pointer.type validation answers first.
// EXTRACT of concept-db src/routes/impulses.ts at 78b70967 (the parent of 23f78717), for the region-mutant arm gate.
// The app constant (:50), its /resolve registration (:524), resolveImpulse's request validation (:534-557, the
// "Missing or invalid pointer.type" 400 verbatim), the three unimplemented write cases (:824-828 verbatim), the case
// after them (:829, reduced), the default (:1276) and the catch (:1288) are kept; the shape guard (:563) is reduced to
// "no caller, no write". Hono and the JWT reader come from ./hono-standin (fixture only), as they come from other
// modules in the original, so the same-file declarations the check reaches are the original's.
import type { Context } from './hono-standin';
import { Hono, getJwtAuthFromContext } from './hono-standin';

export const WRITE_SCOPE = 'write';
export const ADMIN_SCOPE = 'admin';

export function isWriteShape(shape: string): boolean {
  return shape.endsWith('_write');
}

export function mayWriteConcepts(auth: JwtAuthContext | null | undefined): boolean {
  const scopes = Array.isArray(auth?.scopes) ? auth!.scopes : [];
  return scopes.includes(WRITE_SCOPE) || scopes.includes(ADMIN_SCOPE);
}

/**
 * Shapes that write without the `_write` suffix. impulseSignatureConcept
 * upserts a concept whose text is built from the caller's pointer_type and
 * shape, so it needs the write grant like any `_write` shape.
 */
export const UNSUFFIXED_WRITE_SHAPES: readonly string[] = ['impulseSignatureConcept'];

export function needsWriteScope(shape: string): boolean {
  return isWriteShape(shape) || UNSUFFIXED_WRITE_SHAPES.includes(shape);
}

export interface WriteScopeRefusal {
  success: false;
  error: 'Write scope required';
  code: 'WRITE_SCOPE_REQUIRED';
  shape?: string;
  tool?: string;
  message: string;
}

/**
 * The write grant at every concept-db write ingress: this resolve route, the
 * REST writes under /concepts and the MCP tools under /mcp. Null when the
 * caller may write (mayWriteConcepts); otherwise logs one [auth-refused] line
 * at the scope_guard layer and returns the 403 body. Callers check it before
 * any resolver runs, so a refused request writes nothing. The refusal names
 * the scope needed, never the caller's credential.
 */
export function writeScopeRefusal(
  c: Context,
  jwtAuth: JwtAuthContext | null | undefined,
  target: { shape?: string; tool?: string } = {},
): WriteScopeRefusal | null {
  if (mayWriteConcepts(jwtAuth)) return null;
  const route = `${c.req.method} ${c.req.path}`;
  logAuthRefused({
    route,
    shape: target.shape,
    layer: 'scope_guard',
    reason: `WRITE_SCOPE_REQUIRED: credential lacks the write scope${target.tool ? ` (tool ${target.tool})` : ''}`,
    caller_hint: currentRequestAuthScope()?.callerHint ?? callerHint(c),
  });
  const subject = target.shape ? `Shape "${target.shape}"` : target.tool ? `Tool "${target.tool}"` : `"${route}"`;
  return {
    success: false,
    error: 'Write scope required',
    code: 'WRITE_SCOPE_REQUIRED',
    ...(target.shape ? { shape: target.shape } : {}),
    ...(target.tool ? { tool: target.tool } : {}),
    message:
      `${subject} requires a credential issued with the "${WRITE_SCOPE}" scope (or "${ADMIN_SCOPE}"); ` +
      'a read-only credential may read concepts but not write them.',
  };
}

const impulses = new Hono();

impulses.post('/resolve', (c) => resolveImpulse(c));

async function resolveImpulse(c: Context): Promise<Response> {
  const jwtAuth = getJwtAuthFromContext(c);

  let body: any;
  try {
    body = await c.req.json();
  } catch {
    return c.json({ error: 'Invalid JSON body' }, 400);
  }

  const pointer = body?.impulse?.pointer ?? body?.pointer;
  if (!pointer || typeof pointer !== 'object') {
    return c.json({ error: 'Missing required field: pointer' }, 400);
  }

  const shape = pointer.type;
  if (typeof shape !== 'string') {
    return c.json({ error: 'Missing or invalid pointer.type' }, 400);
  }

  if (!jwtAuth && shape.endsWith('_write')) {
    return c.json({ success: false, error: 'Authentication required', code: 'AUTH_REQUIRED', shape }, 401);
  }

  try {
    let result: { content: unknown; metadata: Record<string, unknown> };

    switch (shape) {
      case 'concept_delete_write':
      case 'concept_retire_write':
      case 'concept_supersede_write':
        // Stub to satisfy advertised shape contract. Implementation is pending.
        throw new Error(`'${pointer.shape}' is not yet implemented.`);

      case 'impulseCooccurrenceEdges': {
        result = { content: { edges: [] }, metadata: { shape: 'impulseCooccurrenceEdges', count: 0 } };
        break;
      }

      default:
        return c.json({ error: `Unknown impulse shape: "${shape}"` }, 400);
    }

    return c.json(result);
  } catch (error) {
    const err = error as Error;
    return c.json({ error: 'Resolution failed', shape, message: err.message }, 500);
  }
}

export { impulses };
